statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and a history of atrial fibrillation
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was the service provided
The diagnosis codes billed were Z86.73, I48.91, and R00.2
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on lack of required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is indicated to detect potential embolic sources or rhythm disturbances that may have been missed on standard ECG
